statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The Start-Control-Connection-Request is a PPTP control message used to establish the control connection between a PNS and a PAC. The establishment of the control connection can be initiated by either the PNS or PAC.
actions: initiate control connection establishment between PNS and PAC

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A control connection must be established before any other PPTP messages can be issued.
statements.guard_semantics: connection.established = true is required before any other PPTP message may be issued

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Each PNS-PAC pair requires a dedicated control connection to be established.
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one control connection per PNS-PAC pair
